ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the central angle of sector OAB is $110^\circ$, and C is a point on $\overset{\frown}{AB}$. What is the degree measure of $\angle C$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Construct $\overset{\frown}{AB}$'s corresponding central angle $\angle ADB$, as shown in the diagram,\\
$\therefore \angle ADB = \frac{1}{2}\angle AOB = \frac{1}{2} \times 110^\circ = 55^\circ$,\\
$\because \angle ADB + \angle C = 180^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle C = 180^\circ - 55^\circ = \boxed{125^\circ}$.
